ui.pasteOne: Namarhela URL ya YouTube kumb (Shorts, ku hanya, youtu.be na).
ui.pasteBulk: Namarehela URL yin'we ya YouTube kumb hi layini.
ui.pasteBulkPh: Namarehela URL yin'we ya YouTube kumb hi layini
ui.noIds: Ku hava ID ya vhidiyo leyi kumiweke.
ui.noId: Ku hava ID ya vhidiyo leyi sekeriweke eka tsalwa rero.
ui.foot: Swifaniso swin'tsongo swa YouTube swa vaaki ntsena. Ku hava akhawunti, ku hava ku kopolota vhidiyo, ku hava ku landzelela ti-URL leti namarheliweke.
ui.heroIntro: Kopolota swifaniso swin'tsongo swa YouTube na hi ku hatlisa hi nkoka lowu tlakukeke lowu nga kona, mahala. Humesa u hlayisa swifaniso swa HD ku suka eka vhidiyo yihi na yihi ya YouTube ya vaaki, Shorts, kumbe URL ya hi ku tshikelela kan'we. Namarehela linki ehansi, tshikelela Teka xifaniso xin'tsongo, kutani u kopolota kumbe u avelana linki leyi lulameke.
ui.INVALID_URL: Namarehela URL ya vaaki ya YouTube kumb (swifaniso swa TikTok/Instagram a swi sekeriwangi).
ui.UNSUPPORTED_HOST: Swinene sweswi ku sekeriwa ti-URL ta vaaki ta YouTube na ntsena.
ui.INVALID_VIDEO_ID: Ku hava ID ya vhidiyo leyi lulameke leyi kumiweke eka linki yero.
ui.THUMBNAIL_NOT_FOUND: Ku hava xifaniso xin'tsongo xa vaaki lexi kumiweke eka vhidiyo leyi.
ui.NETWORK_ERROR: Xihoxo xa netiweke xi yimise ku lava. Ringeta nakambe.
ui.TIMEOUT: Nkarhi wo lava xifaniso xin'tsongo wu herile. Ringeta nakambe.
ui.IMAGE_VALIDATION_FAILED: Xifaniso xin'tsongo a xi kotanga ku tiyisisiwa tanihi xifaniso lexi lulameke.
ui.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Fayili a yi kotanga ku kopolotiwa. Pfula xifaniso.
ui.CHANNEL_OR_PLAYLIST: Namarehela ti-URL ta vhidiyo, ku nga ri linki ya cheneli kumbe nxaxamelo.
